name: herbalist_sw_walk_v01
prompt: Use case: identity-preserve hand-painted miniature game animation. Preserve the supplied compact2.7-head NPC's EXACT skull/face/hair crown size, FRONT-LEFT diagonal viewpoint, neck/chest/waist proportions, costume and props. Same upright head and body scale in all FOUR frames. Long deep teal-blue hair in a low flowing ponytail, soft bangs, amber-honey eyes, small ivory flower-and-green-leaf cluster with muted brick-red ribbon by anatomical LEFT ear, human round ears. Ochre/mustard-gold draped shawl/cape with pale botanical border and fine fringes, muted plum-brown fitted overdress over ivory ruffled layered skirt and ivory puff-sleeve blouse, thin brown waist cord with small tassels, brown floral lace-up boots. ONE small wicker herb basket held low in LEFT hand containing green leaves and white blossoms, right hand relaxed. Keep the original shawl draping/long ponytail silhouette and warm gold/plum/ivory palette; no wizard hat or staff. Make FOUR consecutive slow walk poses traveling LOWER-LEFT, in2x2 reading order. Keep the entire original head, shoulders, chest, waist and carried props rigid and unchanged; animate only legs, lower cloth and a restrained free arm. 1 FOREGROUND NEAR leg reaches lower-left heel-contact, FAR leg trails upper-right toe;2 near leg supports under pelvis, FAR knee/boot swings forward;3 OPPOSITE contact: FAR leg now reaches lower-left, foreground NEAR leg trails upper-right with raised heel, near shin overlaps in front at crossing;4 FAR leg supports under pelvis, NEAR knee/boot swings forward. Clearly exchange which leg leads in frame3: not four same-leg lunges or two repeated poses. Keep equal pelvis height, original leg/boot lengths, no head bob/nod/turn or body compression. If both hands carry a prop, keep both hands exactly in the original carrying pose; never add an arm swing third hand. No raising shawl/skirt unnecessarily. Four COMPLETE separate figures inside equal2x2 cells,10% empty margin for full hair/cape/boots and props, no cropping or overlap. True transparent RGBA, nonpixel broad soft shading, no labels/grid/FX/shadow/floor/background gradient.
manual_review: Whole-body review: foreground leg leads in both contact phases; carpenter additionally touches source top. Do not admit.

review_history.reason: Earlier sheet review: contact poses repeat the same leading leg; technical head registration alone is insufficient.
